lines.beaver: 안녕하세요, 김민수 씨. 재판 절차를 상의해 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello, Mr. Kim Minsu. Shall we discuss the trial procedure?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo, gimminsu ssi. jaepan jeolchareul sanguihae bolkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 저작권 문제로 상대방이 저를 고소했어요.
lines.en: Yes, the other party sued me over a copyright issue.
lines.roman: ne, jeojakgwon munjero sangdaebangi jeoreul gosohaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The prosecution has also started an investigation. It's gotten bigger.
lines.learner: 어제 형사와 수사관이 영장을 들고 왔어요.
lines.en: Yesterday a detective and an investigator came with a warrant.
lines.roman: eoje hyeongsawa susagwani yeongjangeul deulgo wasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: So it was a search warrant. What did they take?
lines.en: They took my computer. Am I a suspect?

lines.beaver_en: For now you're a suspect. If indicted, you'll be the defendant.
lines.learner: 그런데 이 계약서는 제가 허락받았음을 말해 줘요.
lines.en: But this contract shows that I had permission.
lines.roman: geureonde i gyeyakseoneun jega heorakbadasseumeul malhae jwoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋은 증거네요. 당사자끼리 풀 수는 없습니까?
lines.beaver_en: That's good evidence. Can't the parties settle it themselves?
lines.beaver_roman: joeun jeunggeoneyo. dangsajakkiri pul suneun eopseumnikka?
lines.en: The other party just won't meet me.

lines.beaver_en: Then we'll have to fight it in court. You must be worried.
lines.learner: 피고로 법정에 서는 건 처음이에요. 설명해 주세요.
lines.en: It's my first time in court as a defendant. Please explain.
lines.roman: pigoro beopjeonge seoneun geon cheoeumieyo. seolmyeonghae juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: A defendant has the right to remain silent.
lines.en: So the constitution protects my rights.

lines.beaver: 맞습니다. 그리고 요즘 새 저작권 법안도 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. And there's also a new copyright bill these days.
lines.beaver_roman: matseumnida. geurigo yojeum sae jeojakgwon beobando isseoyo.
lines.learner: 그 법안이 제 사건에도 영향이 있나요?
lines.en: Does that bill affect my case too?
lines.roman: geu beobani je sageonedo yeonghyangi innayo?

lines.beaver: 아직 통과 전이라 영향은 없습니다. 안심하세요.
lines.beaver_en: It hasn't passed yet, so no effect. Don't worry.
lines.beaver_roman: ajik tonggwa jeonira yeonghyangeun eopseumnida. ansimhaseyo.
lines.learner: 다행이네요. 검찰 조사가 빨리 끝나면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: That's a relief. I hope the prosecution's inquiry ends soon.
lines.roman: dahaengineyo. geomchal josaga ppalli kkeunnamyeon joketseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 준비합시다. 계약서와 메일을 보내 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Then let's prepare. Please send me the contract and emails.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom junbihapsida. gyeyakseowa meireul bonae juseyo.
lines.learner: 네, 오늘 바로 보낼게요. 감사합니다, 변호사님.
lines.en: Okay, I'll send them today. Thank you, sir.
lines.roman: ne, oneul baro bonaelgeyo. gamsahamnida, byeonhosanim.
